name: Functional Manipulation Benchmark (FMB)
summary: 多阶段抓取、重定向与装配示范，提供四视角 RGB-D、机械臂状态、末端力矩和笛卡尔控制动作。
summaryEn: Multistage grasping, reorientation, and assembly demonstrations with four-view RGB-D, robot state, end-effector force/torque, and Cartesian actions.
scaleZh: 单物体及多物体任务共 22,550 条轨迹
access: Official NumPy trajectory archives and detailed data format
accessZh: 官方 NumPy 轨迹包及详细数据格式
verdict: 多阶段接触操作动力学
wmNote: 动作、末端状态与力矩对齐，可研究接触条件预测和长期状态变化；技能标签是注释而非额外控制信号。
wmNoteEn: Aligned actions, end-effector states, and forces support contact/long-term prediction; skill labels are annotations, not extra controls.
